title: 推車恰恰
mood: cheeky, bustling and quick on her feet
subject: a dim sum trolley auntie at one of Hong Kong's last old-style trolley teahouses who knows every regular's order by the sound of their walk, pushing her squeaking trolley through the Sunday morning rush
caption: Cantonese cha-cha-cha in the style of 1960s Hong Kong Cantonese film songs, charanga line-up. A scraped guiro on every beat and the 'cha-cha-chá' on four-and-one, timbales with cowbell, a bright upright piano playing a montuno pattern, a wooden charanga flute trilling over two violins playing short unison riffs, upright bass playing a tumbao. Warm live-room recording with slight tape hiss and room reverb, the whole band audible as one take. A brassy female alto, chatty and teasing, half-calling her lines like a teahouse vendor, the band answering 'cha cha cha' in unison. 120 BPM, Bb major. Cheeky, bustling Sunday-morning rush. No electric organ, no saxophone, no drum kit, no reggaeton beat, no EDM drums, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
朝早六點 茶樓開門
我架車 轆仔吱吱聲
蝦餃燒賣 疊到高過我個頭
蒸氣一噴 我就開工

[Pre-Chorus]
六號枱阿伯 未坐低我都知
拖鞋聲一響 梗係鳳爪排骨

[Chorus]
推車 cha cha cha
叉燒包 熱辣辣
轉個彎 cha cha cha
唔使招手 我嚟緊喇

[Verse]
十點鐘 人逼到出門口
報紙霸位 茶壺揭開蓋
後生仔 揚住張點心紙
我幫你蓋印 你自己揀

[Pre-Chorus]
蒸籠一揭 成堆人企起身
我條腰 扭到好似跳舞咁

[Chorus]
推車 cha cha cha
馬拉糕 熱辣辣
轉個彎 cha cha cha
你哋爭 我照笑住派

[Bridge]
三十年 行同一條通道
左腳右腳 車轆都跟住拍

[Chorus]
推車 cha cha cha
最後一籠 熱辣辣
執埋枱 cha cha cha
聽朝六點 我再嚟過

[Outro]
叉燒包 叉燒包 邊位要
